name: atlas-max
description: Four independent dials — compression (low/high), rigour (ask), check and silent — plus ten subagents that keep searches, logs, pages and big files out of your conversation. Compresses without losing a fact, and refuses to start building before the goal is clear. This variant is everything ATLAS ships: coding, documents and the memory. Install it instead of atlas-code and atlas-mem, never beside them.
